slug: 2025-07-02 MTN Nigeria launches Tier III Sifiso Dabengwa data centre in Lagos (Developing Telecoms)

facts.fact: Developing Telecoms reports MTN Nigeria launched phase 1 of its Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre in Lagos on 1 July 2025, with 780 racks, 4.5MW IT load and a cloud service for customers.

Developing Telecoms states phase 1 of MTN Nigeria's Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre in Lagos, launched 1 July 2025, is a Tier III facility (stated by the outlet; no Uptime Institute certification named); phase 2 is to be built to Tier IV.

systems.country_label: MTN Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre, Lagos

note: Cloud service is MTN's own, not a global provider region; no cloud fact. Phase 2 Tier IV is planned.
